decisions.decision: Store the preorder request and exact product snapshot before revealing an owner-managed payment link.
decisions.reason: A durable request gives the owner a real order desk and prevents a Cash App payment from becoming an untracked message or screenshot.
decisions.limitations: This is a preorder request, not inventory allocation or automatic acceptance.

decisions.decision: Accept only an owner-supplied HTTPS cash.app payment link and generate its QR locally after the preorder is saved.
decisions.reason: Money remains between the customer and Thirst Trap 772 while the site supplies a lower-friction handoff without storing payment credentials or processing funds.
decisions.limitations: FAMtastic cannot prove payment from the QR or link and never marks it paid automatically.

decisions.decision: Initialize every order as requested and every payment as unverified; only an authorized owner can record later fulfillment and payment states.
decisions.reason: Cash App is outside the FAMtastic system, so the owner must compare the order reference against her own account before confirming payment.
decisions.limitations: There is no Cash App webhook, refund automation, chargeback handling, or reconciliation feed.

decisions.decision: Extend the existing phone-first owner studio with numeric preorder prices, Cash App configuration, preorder activation, and an order-status desk.
decisions.reason: The business needs to change the offer and work orders from a phone without exposing settings or customer details on the public page.
decisions.limitations: The verified owner account still must be created and explicitly bound before handoff.

decisions.decision: Ship preorders disabled by default and withhold the private Cash App destination from the public content response.
decisions.reason: No invented price or payment destination may appear before the owner supplies and approves it; a disabled production feature is safer than simulated commerce.
decisions.limitations: The public production page will show the truthful setup state until real prices and the exact owner-generated payment link are entered.
